The '''Rogue Moon Prophecy''' was a prophecy made by the four [[Jedi Consular]]s of the [[Jedi Covenant]]'s [[First WatchCircle]] on the [[Rogue Moon]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3964 BBY]]. After traveling to the moon the Covenant members envisioned that a red-armored [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] would destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]; each master also saw their own deaths caused by the figure. [[Raana Tey]] envisioned herself surrounded by flames on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] invasion, while [[Feln]] saw his death on [[Odryn]]. [[Xamar]] was leading a Republic fleet against the Mandalorians in his vision when his own vessels opened fire on him, and [[Q'Anilia]] saw dead Jedi everywhere while she rushed to save a dead female Jedi on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At the time of their visions, their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] wore similar suits as the armored Sith. As a result, they assumed that one of their students would fall to the dark side, thus leading to the conception and initiation of the [[Padawan Massacre]]. They related this prophecy to the [[Prophecy of the Five]] that their trainer, [[Krynda Draay]], had long ago seen, believing that their apprentices were the Five.

The first two masters fulfilled the prophecies of their own deaths directly. Raana was trapped by debris and tried to use her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to free herself, only for a [[Marn Hierogryph|crimelord]] to misinterpret it as an attack on his [[Zayne Carrick|friend]] and blow up the tower under her. Feln [[Option Ossus|destroyed]] a [[Sanctum of the Exalted|holy place]] and the nearby village, and was murdered by his [[Feeorin/Legends|subjects]]. When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] summoned Xamar to join him in his blockade of Coruscant against [[Zayne Carrick|the lone survivor of the Padawan Massacre]], he feared that he, too, would soon meet his appointed fate, and attempted to change it. However, Xamar was later killed by Admiral Karath's ships while storming the Draay Estate, in accordance with the prophecy, due to the fleet's [[slave circuit]]s having been subverted into doing [[Haazen]]'s bidding.

The final piece of the prophecy was fulfilled when Q'Anilia poisoned herself when she believed Krynda was dead. In her final moments Q'Anilia told Marn Hierogryph of the prophecy, and Gryph realized that ''he'' was "the Sith" who killed them, as he did wear the red spacesuit on [[The Last Resort (starship)|''The Last Resort'']].
